Home.expertiseDesc: Rather than staying tied to one field, I build across every topic that catches my interest: command-line tools, privacy-focused software, developer tools for AI, and analysis tools that examine market data such as stock prices and betting odds. About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: I try to turn the ideas that come to mind into reality, and I keep learning new things along the way.
About.whoAmIDesc: Rather than boxing myself into a single area, I enjoy turning everything that interests me into a project. For a while I worked on game development; for now I have paused that journey and am focusing on more general projects: command-line tools, privacy-focused software, developer tools for AI, and most recently the stock market and financial markets. I am still at the beginning, but I don't just want things; I push myself a little further every day. When something really interests me, I can stay focused on it for a long time. New ideas keep coming to me, and sometimes something I start grows into a much bigger project than I expected. I like remembering details and combining what I have learned before with new ideas.
About.interest1: Command-Line Tools - I write fast, simple tools in Rust and Python that make my everyday tasks easier.
About.interest2: Privacy & Security - I value transparent tools that give users control over their own systems.
About.interest3: AI & Developer Tools - I try out tools that help me work more efficiently with language models.
About.interest4: Markets & Odds Analysis - I am learning how stock markets and betting odds work, and I build my own tools to analyse that data.
About.interest5: Linux & Open Source - Tools I use every day, and I enjoy sharing my projects as open source.
About.philosophyDesc: I always want to get better. Being told that I can't do something usually doesn't stop me. It makes me want to work harder. I like learning from my mistakes, moving forward, and constantly pushing myself a little further.
About.currentWorkDesc: At the moment I am focused on finishing my projects in different areas one after another. While I build analysis tools for stock and odds data, I am also developing this website and collecting what I build here.
